definitions.explanation: Meeting or interacting directly with someone in the same physical location, as opposed to online or remote communication.

examples.japanese: {対面|たいめん}で⟦{話|はな}したい→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
{対面|たいめん}で⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた。

⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{対面|たいめん}で⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けたい→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many students prefer to take classes in person rather than online.

notes:
USAGE:
Became especially common after the COVID-19 pandemic as a contrast to online or remote interactions. Used with で as an adverb, or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns ({対面|たいめん}で⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対面|たいめん}で⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (to meet in person)
- {対面|たいめん}で⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to talk face-to-face)
- {対面|たいめん}で⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (in-person classes)
- {対面|たいめん}で⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧ (in-person interview)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (online)
- ⟦リモート→リモート：04743_rimooto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (remotely)
